heading: State historic preservation review board
lead: In this division, the term “State historic preservation review board” means a board, council, commission, or other similar collegial body established as provided in section 302301(2) of this title—

tree.text: the members of which are appointed by the State Historic Preservation Officer (unless otherwise provided for by State law);

a majority of the members of which are professionals qualified in history, prehistoric and historic archeology, architectural history, architecture, folklore, cultural anthropology, curation, conservation, landscape architecture, and related disciplines; and

children.text: review National Register nominations and appeals from nominations;
review appropriate documentation submitted in conjunction with the Historic Preservation Fund;
provide general advice and guidance to the State Historic Preservation Officer; and
perform such other duties as may be appropriate.
